_comment: Labels for issue priority triage (ADR-0026). The apply job creates any that are missing; it never edits or deletes an existing label. Names, colours and descriptions match the labels already in the repository. Owners map an area to the GitHub login assigned when an issue has no assignee; "*" is the fallback.

sev:critical.description: Unapproved command runs, privilege escalation, data loss, or a secret leaks

sev:major.description: Safety check bypassed or silently off, session ends, or core feature broken with no workaround

sev:minor.description: Wrong behaviour with a workaround, or a visible degradation

sev:trivial.description: Cosmetic, wording, docs, or a test-only gap

reach:edge.description: Needs an unusual setup, input or timing

reach:adversarial.description: Only triggers when someone sets it up on purpose

area:terminal.description: Terminal ownership and the output mirror

area:targets.description: OS targets and their data (incl. the command provider)

area:docs.description: ADRs, specs, threat model and other docs

priority:P0.description: Drop other work, fix now, block the release (ADR-0026)

priority:P2.description: Next milestone, or whenever it fits (ADR-0026)

needs-triage.description: Severity or reach could not be placed; says what is missing
